Pathway-based connections among gene signatures significantly perturbed by DA in U1 latent cells

Pathway-based connections among gene signatures significantly perturbed by DA in U1 latent cells. Pathway-based gene networks identified in: (A,C) Clusters 2 and 10 that characterize U1 latent cells, in comparison to (B,D) Clusters 3 and 6 that characterized DA-treated cells exhibiting latency reversal. The most significant pathway annotations were (A,B) ribosomal control of transcription (Benjamini, p = 3.9 × 10−58) and (C,D) proteasome (Benjamini, p = 4.4 × 10−8). Colors indicate upregulation (shades of red) and downregulation (shades of blue). Blue connectors indicate links through pathway
